purpose: Prove the deterministic Site Intelligence pipeline end to end on an
Education corpus: role classification without structured data, knowledge
extraction, document inventory, temporal handling, question coverage,
journey coverage, and full-denominator dimension scores.
SYNTHETIC. Every name, amount, address, and contact is invented. No
customer copy is reproduced here — customer corpora belong in
docs/evaluations/ and never become shared pack fixtures.
